purpose: Command-grade Wraith combat clothing/armour rebuilt only from Stargate Atlantis production references. A fitted green-black leather and black reptile-leather commander uniform sits beneath screen-used Wraith silver hard-rubber carapace and simulated-bone shoulder protection, all translated onto vanilla RimWorld PowerArmor geometry. It must read as Stargate Wraith wardrobe first and armour second, never as generic panelled sci-fi plate.

required_terms: hard rubber silver front and back armor

construction: fitted green-black Wraith commander leather uniform as the continuous base garment
black reptile-pattern leather vest and upper-back yoke taken from screen-used commander tailoring
single anatomically coherent silver hard-rubber front/back carapace rather than stacks of invented plates
layered simulated-bone shoulder protection derived from screen-used Wraith drone armour
flexible dark leather left visible at waist, flanks, inner arms and joints
side/back lacing, snaps and closure hardware as practical costume construction
small restrained thigh guards only where the PowerArmor silhouette needs lower-body protection
production wear, rubbed edges and hand-built irregularity

primary_research_basis: Propworx screen-used Wraith male commander costume: green leather trenchcoat; black reptile-pattern leather vest with epaulettes, snaps, zipper and side/back lacing; black leather trousers, gauntlets and boots

Propworx Wraith Drone Uniform technical description: black leather under-vest; hard-rubber silver front/back carapace with clear covering; simulated-bone silver shoulder and thigh armour; leather chaps, greaves and gauntlets
Val Halverson costume-designer Q&A: Wraith costumes use substantial real leather, contrast leather, gauntlets and belts as constructed wardrobe rather than generic painted sci-fi surfaces

stage_2_rimworld.readability_rule: must read as a continuous Stargate Wraith command uniform with integrated screen-derived carapace at 192x192; no invented pawn silhouette

layered dark silver Wraith back shell
